messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Increased 5xx rate and elevated p95 latency for /v1/chat; also seeing spikes on embeddings and rerank routes. Impact: some customers seeing timeouts. Paging #eng-oncall.

mike: I see traces — chat generating a lot of long-context requests, KV cache pressure + continuous batching saturation. Embeddings batcher spilling to CPU.

sarah: Confirmed. Top offenders: customer A (chat heavy), customer C (embedding bulk uploads), and internal rerank job stuck retrying.

alice: Quick question — do we want to throttle globally or per-route? Prefer per-route since chat is primary revenue path.

mike: Agreed. Plan: apply route-specific quota changes: tighten embeddings and rerank, leave chat with a conservative soft-limit and prioritized tokens for paid tiers.

ben: Who can push the quota tweak? I can hit the admin API. Suggest these deltas: embeddings: reduce max_rps from 200 -> 50, rerank: disable auto-retries + set max_concurrent 4, chat: set soft_rps 120 -> 80 and enable premium-priority.

alice: +1. Also enable short-lived per-account backoff for large embedding uploads.

mike: Do it. I'll monitor traces and flamegraphs.

ben: Running command now (internal admin):
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/redwood/v1/quotas/update \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{
    "changes": [
      {"route":"/v1/embeddings","max_rps":"50","note":"emergency throttle 2026-03-15"},
      {"route":"/v1/rerank","max_concurrent":"4","retries":"0","note":"disable retries during incident"},
      {"route":"/v1/chat","soft_rps":"80","priority_policy":"paid-first"}
    ]
  }'
```

deploy-bot: quota update job queued (job id: q-31999-77). Applying to 3 regions: us-east1, eu-west1, ap-southeast1.

mike: I patched the rate-limiter config on the gateway to apply route tags so traffic shaping works per-route.

deploy-bot: job q-31999-77 succeeded in us-east1. eu-west1 applying. ap-southeast1 pending.

alice: Observability: p95 latency for embeddings dropped from 2.4s -> 700ms in us-east1 after throttle. Chat p95 increased slightly but error rate down.

mike: Good. For rerank, I also applied a temporary feature flag to disable vector re-ranking heuristic that hits a heavy CPU path: `features.rerank.heuristic=false` 

ben: Confirmed rerank queue drained, retries stopped.

jay: Customer impact notes for SRE report: customer C embedding uploads slowed and some timeouts retried client-side; customer A chat saw slower throughput but no data loss. Logging customer support tickets.

alice: Can we add a per-customer override for customer A to maintain their prior soft_rps? They have an active SLO contract.

mike: Yes, doing account-level exception: set customerA -> chat soft_rps 160 scoped to account id 1234 for 30m. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: account override applied for account 1234 in us-east1.

ben: Monitoring metrics: overall 5xx count dropping, system error budget recovering. Still watching KV cache eviction rate.

mike: Next steps: leave these temporary quotas for 30 minutes, then re-evaluate. If stable, move to gradual rollback and plan a follow-up runbook to optimize embedding batcher and rerank CPU path.

alice: I'll file a post-incident action item: "Investigate embedding bulk-upload flow and add per-upload chunking + server-side streaming" and assign to eng-runtime.

jay: Handoff to night on-call in 20m — @sarah please summarize for handoff.

sarah: Summary for night: we've applied emergency per-route throttles: embeddings -> 50 rps, rerank concurrency 4 with retries disabled, chat soft_rps 80 with paid-priority; customer A override kept at 160. Issue appears caused by long-context chat + large embedding batches. Primary mitigation is throttling; next is runtime fixes scheduled. Continue to watch p95, 5xx, KV eviction.

mike: Great. I'll stay for the handoff and remain available for 15m. :thumbsup:

ben: Closing pager thread but keep incident channel open for follow-ups.

incident-bot: Pager marked acknowledged by mike.
